description: Computes a run's parameters_version from the file hash and its optional weights override.
signature: def run_parameters_version(path: Path, weights_override: Mapping[str, float] | None) -> str
docstring:
Return parameters_version(path) when there is no override, otherwise load the locked weights, resolve the override and return effective_parameters_version.

Raises:
    ParameterError: unreadable file or invalid override.
postconditions: Equals parameters_version(path) when weights_override is None or empty
